deadline.value: Priority deadline December 1; later applications reviewed on a rolling basis until February 1.
deadline.quote: For priority consideration, completed applications should be received by December 1.

app_fee.value: USD 65 for international applicants; the department reimburses it if you are admitted.
app_fee.quote: The application fee for the Chemistry PhD is $55 for Domestic applicants and $65 for International applicants.

also.quote: Upon your admittance into our program we will reimburse this cost.

fee_waiver.value: No fee waiver for international applicants before applying; the fee is reimbursed only after admission.
fee_waiver.quote: International application fee waiver is NOT available prior to applying.

gre_general.quote: No, GRE scores are not needed when applying.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores, including the subject test, are not needed.
gre_subject.quote: No, GRE scores are not needed when applying.

toefl_min.value: Department asks for TOEFL iBT 105 (higher than the university minimum); Duolingo 135.

ielts_min.value: Department asks for IELTS 7 overall (higher than the university minimum).

english_waiver.value: An English-medium degree from India does not waive the test; only degrees from Australia, Canada (except Quebec), New Zealand, Puerto Rico or the UK do.
english_waiver.quote: if country is not listed above and mode of instruction was in English, YOU ARE STILL REQUIRED TO PROVIDE OFFICIAL SCORES

supervisor.value: No need to find an advisor before applying, but research interests should match the department.
supervisor.quote: Do I need to find a research advisor before applying? | No, however, your research interests should align with our research offerings.

funding.value: The department page does not describe stipend or funding for PhD students.

entry_route.value: A recognized four-year degree is enough; the department admits PhD students only.
entry_route.quote: Graduation with a recognized four-year degree

also.quote: No, accepting applications for prospective PhD students ONLY

notes: Dates are shown without a year; the 2026/27 cycle is assumed.
